question: Who bagged the women's singles title at Syed Modi International Badminton Tournament, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Sindhu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PV Sindhu** won the **women's singles title** at the **Syed Modi International Badminton Tournament, 2022**.
 
• She **defeated Malvika Bansod **in the final to clinch the title.
 
• The Syed Modi International Badminton Tournament is an annual event held in India and is part of the Badminton World Federation (BWF) Tour.
 
• PV Sindhu is one of India's most successful badminton players, having won multiple international titles including the World Championships and an Olympic silver medal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PV Sindhu** has been awarded several honors by the Government of India, including the **Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna**.
 
• The Syed Modi International Badminton Tournament is named after Syed Modi, an Indian badminton player who was a national champion and won the All England Championship in 1981.
 
• The tournament attracts top badminton players from around the world and is a significant event in the badminton calendar.
 
• PV Sindhu's victory at the Syed Modi International Badminton Tournament, 2022, adds to her illustrious career and highlights her consistent performance in the sport.
